title: Enterprise Support: Compute contract price evidence for source-line debit assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Compute contract price evidence for source-line debit assessment.

## Decision basis

For source-line debit assessment: Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same legal billing entity; use its authorized signed negotiated unit rate, otherwise its tier standard primary unit rate. If there is no matching compute contract, the reconstructed compute rate is zero and no compute-spend contribution is recognized.

For source-line debit assessment: This reconstruction values actual exported compute usage; it does not grant a support discount.

## Points of judgment

For source-line debit assessment: An authorized negotiated price on the matching active compute contract supplies the selected price; otherwise the selected price comes from that contract’s tier. The matching contract belongs to the same customer and legal billing entity.
